data.description: Standard base64 of the stored bytes, ready for an MCP image or text content block.

AttachmentRef.description: One staged attachment as the in-session MCP tools see it (D-028 §4.5, generalized to arbitrary files in D-027b). Metadata only; `AttachmentContent` adds the bytes.

instanceId.description: Session this attachment is staged for; also the read-authorization key.

index.description: 1-based number matching the prompt's `[Image #n]`/`[File #n]` token, assigned by the send manifest that consumed the object; null while the object is only staged. `remuda_attachments_list` is ordered by this number.

AttachmentUpload.description: Staged attachment metadata (D-027/D-027b). Images are magic-byte sniffed; other files keep their validated declared media type. `name` is the sanitised original filename or null when none was supplied, and `storedName` is always the derived internal name.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes.

expiresAt.description: RFC3339. Staging is lazily expired, not swept by a job.

kind.description: `image` for sniffed PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP; `file` for everything else.

name.description: Sanitised original filename, or null when the upload carried none.

children.description: Direct children created by this instance; descendants do not inherit scope.

origin.description: Authenticated origin; clients must treat an unknown origin as Agent.

EffortSelection.description: Native effort selection (D-028 §9.1): the harness-native level plus an orthogonal ultracode boolean (Claude only). Claude takes low | medium | high | xhigh | max; Codex takes low | medium | high | xhigh | max | ultra. Codex accepts legacy minimal as low; ultra is a real Codex level, independent of the Claude-only ultracode flag. Legacy tier names (default / think / think-hard / ultracode) are accepted and normalized by NAME — never by index, because the old per-harness tables differed in length.

name.description: low | medium | high | xhigh | max | ultra (ultra is Codex-only), or a legacy tier name to be normalized; Codex minimal maps to low.

ultracode.description: Dynamic workflow. Equivalent to xhigh plus dynamic workflow; session-only, never persisted as a level.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Instance creation uses PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED for an explicit gateway request without a matching provider profile and PLACEMENT_UNSATISFIABLE for unsatisfied placement constraints. A `via` delivery that cannot be honoured is refused with one of ApiViaRefusal (`api-via-unknown-host` 400, `api-via-host-offline` / `api-via-unsupported` / `api-via-unreachable` 409) rather than silently delivered direct.

FleetBroadcast.description: Select running instances and fan one command out. Requires `all` or at least one of `hosts` / `labels` / `kinds`; filters intersect. Agent broadcasts are checked before dispatch; cross-instance sends and all key input require Human approval.

all.description: Forbidden from Agent origin, even with filters. Human/Bot callers must also set confirm=true.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation of an all broadcast; does not exempt Agent callers.

idempotencyKey.description: Base key; each instance is queued under `<key>:<instanceId>` so a retry replays instead of double-sending.

warnings.description: Advisory over-limit CPU/mem readings for explicitly requested (pinned) hosts; the fleet was still created.

claudeBinaryPath.description: Per-host default claude executable. Empty string clears the default.

defaultLaunchArgs.description: Per-host default extra CLI args. Null clears the default.

defaultTui.description: Per-host requested renderer. Null restores the fullscreen default.

relayBind.description: D-047 Amendment A1 explicit relay bind. Null clears it back to loopback-only; the Hub rejects 0.0.0.0/:: and public addresses.

HostResources.description: Node-reported load snapshot, persisted verbatim. Placement only trusts cpuPct/memPct when sampledAt is within the freshness window (60 s); older samples trigger a bounded host.resources refresh before a refusal.

cpuCount.description: Logical CPU count reported by the Node.

sampledAt.description: Hub-stamped RFC3339 time the sample was received (hello, heartbeat, or on-demand refresh). Placement compares this to the Hub clock.

relayBind.description: Explicit relay bind for direct-network routing (D-047 Amendment A1). Absent keeps the relay on loopback; the Hub refuses wildcards and public addresses, and `route: direct-net` is 409 `api-via-unreachable` until one is set.

claudeBinaryPath.description: Per-host default claude executable. Validated by the Node, not the Hub.

defaultLaunchArgs.description: Per-host default extra CLI args, used when a create omits args.

resources.description: Latest CPU/mem snapshot with Hub-stamped sample time.

defaultTui.description: Per-host requested renderer. Null restores the fullscreen default.

workspaceId.description: Canonical target workspace for a mutation

path.description: Absolute path on the Node, within its configured workspace roots

apiRoute.description: Route sub-mode for apiVia: auto | hub-relay | direct-net (D-047 Amendment A1). `auto` probes the proxy host's relayBind and falls back to hub-relay; direct-net is a hard 409 `api-via-unreachable` when no bind is configured.

apiVia.description: Per-dispatch delivery override (D-047): a proxy host id, `self` for the Hub process, or `none` to force direct. The D-047 waterfall is request > project > profile > direct; unknown/offline/unsupported targets refuse with the api-via-* codes, never a silent fallback.

args.description: Extra native CLI arguments as an argv array, never a shell string. Checked against the per-driver launch allowlist; replaces the host default when present.

binaryPath.description: Host-absolute executable override. The Node validates and pins it; the Hub only stores the string.

binarySha256.description: Expected sha256: digest of binaryPath. The launch is refused when the Node's pin disagrees.

role.description: Preset name applied at create and stored for display; enforcement reads scope+grants, never this field (design §2.5).

worktree.description: Worktree name created by remuda worktree create.

tui.description: Requested renderer. Omission inherits the host default, then fullscreen.

warnings.description: Non-fatal placement warnings, e.g. an explicitly pinned host over its CPU/memory ceiling. Auto-placement refuses those hosts instead of returning a warning; each warning is also journaled against the new instance.

nodePurge.description: Outcome of the Node `instance.purge` call; the Hub record is deleted either way.

token.description: Bearer credential; keep secret and do not journal it.

activity.description: idle only after a Node/herdr agent_status or session idle observation. Create default is unknown.

apiRoute.description: Model-API route this instance actually uses (D-047); absent on a direct session.

effortIndex.description: Legacy per-harness table index. Preserved for older clients; never used to derive the tier, because the old tables differed in length per harness.

effortEffective.description: D-028 §9.1 effective effort read back from the native transcript ({name, ultracode, source, observedAt}). This is the OBSERVED tier, not the requested one: null means no assistant record has reported a level yet, and clients must show `?` rather than fall back to effortName. source is launch|slash|remuda|unknown.

ultracode.description: Observed dynamic-workflow flag; null unless positively observed (the native transcript spells ultracode as xhigh and omits the boolean).

effortName.description: Normalized D-028 §9.1 effort level. Legacy tiers stored on older rows are mapped by name on read (default→low, think→high, think-hard→xhigh, ultracode→xhigh with effortUltracode true). Codex minimal maps to low; Codex max and ultra persist unchanged. Ultra is rejected by Claude, agy and Grok.

effortUltracode.description: Dynamic-workflow flag (`--effort ultracode`). Session-only; it is xhigh plus dynamic workflow, not a sixth level.

modelEffective.description: D-028 §9.1 effective model read back from the /model <local-command-stdout> verdict or message.model ({id, source, observedAt}). This is the RESOLVED id (an alias can resolve to a concrete gateway id), not necessarily the requested word.

modelCatalog.description: D-028 §9.1 the model list this session can switch to, discovered from the gateway cache (gateway-discovery), settings/env (settings), or the built-in aliases (builtin). {models: string[], source, observedAt}.

modelPinMismatches.description: model-pin-1 §5.4: recorded launch model-pin divergences projected from the Node's model_pin_mismatch diagnostics, verbatim ({requested, observed, observedAt}). Durable across the bounded journal tail; rendered in run details. Only sessions whose launch diagnostic is folded after the projection shipped are populated.

launchedBy.description: Who ran the launch command (D-028 §1.0 rule 4). Provenance only, never a capability level: a user-launched session is entitled to exactly the same signals as a Remuda-launched one. Derived from mode/promotedAt for rows written before D-028.

lifecycle.description: Derived from Node lifecycle observations in journal.append. Create default is requested, not running.

mode.description: How this instance reached its kind. "promoted" means a terminal instance had a known agent CLI take over its PTY foreground (D-025); the driver stays shell-pty.

nativeSessionId.description: Native session id the driver reported; what POST /v1/instances/{id}/resume passes to `claude --resume` (D-026).

nativeTranscriptPath.description: Native transcript path, when a driver reported one (D-026).

parentInstanceId.description: Immutable creator instance, recorded by the Hub from authenticated identity.

promotedAt.description: When the terminal was promoted. Absent unless mode is "promoted".

resumedFrom.description: Exited instance whose conversation this instance continues (D-026).

signalTier.description: Signal tier confirmed by the Node for the current native session. Absent until a tier has been observed.

tui.description: Requested launch renderer. Actual mode is reported by tty snapshot altScreen.

usageRollup.description: Additive per-session token/context rollup (context-usage-1), Hub-computed from the journal's usage observations and refreshed every turn. Absent until the harness has reported at least one usage event; every counter is null until the adapter reports that channel (never a fabricated zero).

InstanceUsageRollup.description: Per-session token/context rollup for the composer context chip popover (context-usage-1). An additive projection of the journal's usage observations recomputed on read, so the TPM windows never go stale. Every counter is null until at least one usage observation has reported that channel (Codex/Grok adapters report only subsets).

cacheCreationTokens.description: Sum of prompt-cache creation (write) tokens across the session; null when never reported.

cacheReadTokens.description: Sum of prompt-cache read tokens across the session; null when never reported.

contextPct.description: contextUsedTokens / contextWindowTokens, rounded and clamped to 0..100; null until both are known.

contextUsedTokens.description: Tokens the next request carries: the last turn's fresh input + cache read + cache creation; null when no component was reported.

contextWindowTokens.description: Context window size from the [1m] tag, the model catalog, or the harness kind; null for kinds without a known window.

lastTurnAt.description: Observed-at timestamp of the most recent usage event.

sessionInputTokens.description: Sum of fresh (uncached) input tokens across the session; null when never reported.

sessionOutputTokens.description: Sum of output tokens across the session; null when never reported.

tpmIn5m.description: Average per-minute input rate over the last 5 minutes (window sum / 5); null when no input-bearing turn lies in the window.

tpmIn60s.description: Fresh input tokens observed during the last 60 seconds; null when no input-bearing turn lies in the window.

tpmOut5m.description: Average per-minute output rate over the last 5 minutes (window sum / 5); null when no output-bearing turn lies in the window.

tpmOut60s.description: Output tokens observed during the last 60 seconds; null when no output-bearing turn lies in the window.

turns.description: Number of usage observations folded (one per model turn for Claude).

InstanceScope.description: Delegation-tree resource reach (design §2.5). Empty dimensions mean 'not narrowed'; child scope must be a subset of the parent.

supplyGrants.description: Provider profile ids this node may spend (structured grants land with co-supply).

fromSeq.description: Window floor (seq of events[0]); null for an empty window.

reachedAfterSeq.description: False when rows below the window floor were cut; descend with beforeSeq=fromSeq-1.

Images (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP) are magic-byte sniffed and the declared Content-Type must agree; other files keep a validated declared media type, are served back with attachment disposition + nosniff, and are never executed. Limits: 25 MiB per attachment by default (config key attachmentMaxBytes / REMUDA_ATTACHMENT_MAX_BYTES), 256 MiB staged per instance, 8 attachments per send. The optional `name` query parameter carries the original filename; it is sanitised (no path separators or control characters, length-capped).

post.summary: Read one regular file on a host and stage it as a Hub object (read-only)
post.description: Operator (Human/Bot) only; Agent origin is 403. The Node validates containment, reads the regular file, uploads the bytes with its host token, and returns objectId/digest/size. Bytes are fetched separately via GET /v1/objects/{objectId}.

post.summary: Search file names or contents on a host under a registered workspace (read-only, bounded)
post.description: Operator (Human/Bot) only; Agent origin is 403. Proxied to the addressed online Node's host.files.search RPC. The Node confines the walk to a registered workspace root or the /tmp/remuda-* scratch area, honours .gitignore, skips binary and irregular files, and bounds the scan by wall clock (10s), total bytes (10 MiB), per-file bytes (1 MiB) and result count (default 200); the reply carries truncated/truncatedReason when a bound is hit. A Node that does not implement the method answers with a JSON-RPC error, surfaced as a clean 400.

relPath.description: Workspace-relative subtree; absent names the workspace root.

query.description: Literal needle, or a regex when regex=true.

mode.description: name (default) matches entry names; content matches decoded file contents line by line.

maxResults.description: Cap on returned matches; absent means the Node default (200).

line.description: 1-based content line; 0 for a name hit.

post.summary: Node-facing: stage bytes read from a host's workspace
post.description: Authenticated with the addressed Node's durable host token (not a device token); a token bound to another host is 403. Raw octet-stream body capped by the Hub's attachmentMaxBytes. Stored as application/octet-stream with nosniff; bytes read back through GET /v1/objects/{objectId}.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Sanitized basename of the read file.
